fn drain_matrix_controls(controls: &mut [Consumer<Record>; 4], rounds: &mut core::ops::RangeFrom<u32>) {
    #[cfg(any())]
    let rounds = [0_u8; 2];
    for (lane, _) in rounds.enumerate() {
        let available = controls[lane].available_at_entry();
        for _ in 0..available {
            let Ok(record) = controls[lane].try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            apply(record);
        }
    }
}
